title: What Happens When a Group Calls
summary: Three out of four group inquiries in one hotel-call sample were new conversations. A group call is a lead, and it needs a path that keeps the request intact when the group desk is closed.
body_markdown:
Common questions


## FAQ


### Who should handle group booking calls at a hotel?


The team that can quote and hold group business, usually a group or reservations team, or events when the request includes a meeting room. Front-desk staff can take a name but are not set up to quote a group rate or hold rooms across several dates.


When that team is closed, the call should reach the next approved department or become a written record with the caller's number and the request, so the group team can follow up.


### What counts as a group booking at a hotel?


Each hotel sets its own threshold, usually a number of rooms above which a request goes to the group team instead of being booked like an individual stay. Requests that include a meeting room or event space are usually handled separately again, as event business.


Codyco usually books ordinary room requests up to a certain size and hands larger ones, and anything the caller describes as a group or an event, to the team the hotel has named.


### What happens to a group inquiry that calls a hotel after hours?


Unless the hotel has planned for it, the call rings out or reaches someone who cannot quote it. Group inquiries are often first contacts: in one published sample of 8,944 calls across eleven German hotels, three out of four reviewed group and event inquiries were new conversations.


A first contact that reaches nobody leaves nothing to follow up, so the call should move to a backup department or end in a written handover with the caller's number and the request.


### Can an AI phone agent take a group booking?


It should hand the group request to a person. Group business involves rates, contingents and often meeting rooms, and those need someone with authority to decide. Codyco usually books ordinary room requests up to a certain size and forwards group inquiries to the right person. If the team cannot answer, Codyco captures the request and creates a structured handover with the caller's number.


### Why do group calls deserve more attention than their volume suggests?


Because they are usually new business. In one published sample of 8,944 calls across eleven German hotels, three out of four reviewed group and event inquiries were new conversations rather than follow-ups on an existing proposal. Group and event calls were a minority of total volume, but each one is often the start of a sale the hotel has not yet quoted.


### Who handles changes to an existing group booking?


The group team. Questions about an existing group reservation, extensions and cancellations should go to the team that holds the contingent, not the front desk. With Codyco, calls about existing bookings are split the same way as new requests: group bookings to the group team, individual bookings to reservations.
